fact: The Ministry of Digital held a workshop on 2-3 February 2022 that analysed and validated five books of public-sector digital standards, Book 5 being the Référentiel Général d'Interopérabilité, with a restricted commission to finalise the texts before promulgation.

The government adopted the draft digital norms and standards for the public sector on 15 April 2022, in five books including the Référentiel Général d'Interopérabilité; the minister said legal fixing would follow by ministerial order (arrêté), which the article does not report as issued.
